title: AI Compliance Questionnaire
description: A short compliance questionnaire for companies that want a fast readiness check.

questions.label: Is this actually an AI system?
questions.helperText: If the product is not an AI system, the rest of this quick audit will not apply.

questions.label: Is it placed on the market, put into service, or used in the EU?
questions.helperText: This is the minimum EU connection needed for this quick audit.

questions.label: What is your company’s main role?

options.label: We build or place the AI system on the market
We use the AI system in our business
We import the AI system into the EU
We distribute or resell the AI system

questions.label: Which other frameworks or standards matter for this assessment?
questions.helperText: Optional. This helps tailor the result beyond the quick EU-facing check.

options.label: NIST AI RMF
ISO/IEC 42001
GDPR and data protection controls
UK AI governance or assurance expectations
Internal AI governance policy

questions.label: Does your AI do any of the following?
questions.helperText: Select only if the use case clearly applies.

options.label: Harmful manipulation or deception (Art. 5(1)(a))
Exploiting vulnerabilities due to age, disability or social/economic situation (Art. 5(1)(b))
Social scoring (Art. 5(1)(c))
Individual criminal-risk prediction based solely on profiling (Art. 5(1)(d))
Untargeted facial-image scraping for recognition databases (Art. 5(1)(e))
Emotion recognition in workplace or education (Art. 5(1)(f))
Biometric categorisation inferring sensitive attributes (Art. 5(1)(g))
Real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement (Art. 5(1)(h))

questions.label: Is your AI used in any of these higher-risk contexts?

options.label: Biometric identification or categorisation (Annex III(1))
Critical infrastructure safety management (Annex III(2))
Education or vocational training (Annex III(3))
Employment, workers management or access to self-employment (Annex III(4))
Essential private/public services and benefits (Annex III(5))
Law enforcement (Annex III(6))
Migration, asylum or border control (Annex III(7))
Administration of justice or democratic processes (Annex III(8))

questions.label: Is the AI a safety component of, or itself a product covered by, Annex I harmonisation legislation requiring third-party conformity assessment?
For an Annex III use, is the system only performing a narrow procedural or preparatory task without materially influencing a decision?
questions.helperText: This is the Art. 6(3) exception route and requires documented assessment.

questions.label: Does the system provide, modify, or rely on a general-purpose AI model?
Does your AI generate content or interact directly with people?

options.label: People interact with it like a chatbot or assistant
It generates or manipulates synthetic content

questions.label: Do you have clear human oversight for important decisions?
Do you have documented risk controls and monitoring in place?
Do you already have the core compliance documentation and evidence prepared?
If this is high-risk, are you ready for conformity and registration steps?
questions.helperText: If your system is not high-risk, select Yes.
